<script>
/**
 * MediaKit — runs in the browser.
 *  • analyze(file): reads photo/video details locally (nothing is uploaded to do this).
 *    For MP4/MOV it reads the file's own metadata boxes: codecs, frame rate, rotation,
 *    duration, "fast start", edit lists.
 *  • thumbnail(file): small JPEG preview stored with the library entry.
 *  • upload(file, folderId): sends the ORIGINAL file, unchanged, straight to your Google Drive.
 */
(function () {
  'use strict';

  /* ---------- Low-level box reading for MP4 / MOV ---------- */
  function readSlice(file, start, end) {
    return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
      var r = new FileReader();
      r.onload = function () { resolve(r.result); };
      r.onerror = function () { reject(r.error); };
      r.readAsArrayBuffer(file.slice(start, end));
    });
  }
  function fourcc(dv, o) { return String.fromCharCode(dv.getUint8(o), dv.getUint8(o + 1), dv.getUint8(o + 2), dv.getUint8(o + 3)); }
  function u64(dv, o) { return dv.getUint32(o) * 4294967296 + dv.getUint32(o + 4); }

  async function topLevelBoxes(file) {
    var boxes = [], offset = 0, guard = 0;
    while (offset + 8 <= file.size && guard++ < 500) {
      var dv = new DataView(await readSlice(file, offset, Math.min(offset + 16, file.size)));
      var size = dv.getUint32(0), type = fourcc(dv, 4), header = 8;
      if (size === 1 && dv.byteLength >= 16) { size = u64(dv, 8); header = 16; }
      else if (size === 0) size = file.size - offset;
      if (size < header || !/^[\x20-\x7e]{4}$/.test(type)) break;
      boxes.push({ type: type, offset: offset, size: size, header: header });
      offset += size;
    }
    return boxes;
  }

  var CONTAINERS = { moov: 1, trak: 1, mdia: 1, minf: 1, stbl: 1, edts: 1 };
  var VCODEC = { avc1: 'h264', avc3: 'h264', hvc1: 'hevc', hev1: 'hevc', vp09: 'vp9', vp08: 'vp8', av01: 'av1', mp4v: 'mpeg4',
    ap4h: 'prores', ap4x: 'prores', apch: 'prores', apcn: 'prores', apcs: 'prores', apco: 'prores' };
  var ACODEC = { mp4a: 'aac', Opus: 'opus', opus: 'opus', '.mp3': 'mp3', lpcm: 'pcm', sowt: 'pcm', twos: 'pcm', in24: 'pcm', in32: 'pcm', fl32: 'pcm', 'ac-3': 'ac3', 'ec-3': 'eac3', alac: 'alac' };

  function parseMoov(buf) {
    var dv = new DataView(buf);
    var tracks = [], mvhd = null, cur = null;
    function walk(start, end) {
      var o = start;
      while (o + 8 <= end) {
        var size = dv.getUint32(o), type = fourcc(dv, o + 4), h = 8;
        if (size === 1) { size = u64(dv, o + 8); h = 16; }
        if (size < h || o + size > end) break;
        var b = o + h; // body start
        if (type === 'trak') { cur = { }; tracks.push(cur); walk(b, o + size); cur = null; }
        else if (CONTAINERS[type]) walk(b, o + size);
        else if (type === 'mvhd') {
          var v = dv.getUint8(b);
          mvhd = v === 1 ? { timescale: dv.getUint32(b + 20), duration: u64(dv, b + 24) } : { timescale: dv.getUint32(b + 12), duration: dv.getUint32(b + 16) };
        } else if (cur && type === 'tkhd') {
          var tv = dv.getUint8(b), m = b + (tv === 1 ? 52 : 40);
          cur.matrix = [dv.getInt32(m), dv.getInt32(m + 4), dv.getInt32(m + 12), dv.getInt32(m + 16)];
          cur.width = dv.getUint32(m + 36) / 65536; cur.height = dv.getUint32(m + 40) / 65536;
        } else if (cur && type === 'mdhd') {
          var mv = dv.getUint8(b);
          cur.timescale = mv === 1 ? dv.getUint32(b + 20) : dv.getUint32(b + 12);
          cur.duration = mv === 1 ? u64(dv, b + 24) : dv.getUint32(b + 16);
        } else if (cur && type === 'hdlr') { if (!cur.handler) cur.handler = fourcc(dv, b + 8); }
        else if (cur && type === 'stsd') { if (dv.getUint32(b + 4) > 0) cur.codec = fourcc(dv, b + 12); }
        else if (cur && type === 'stts') {
          var n = dv.getUint32(b + 4), samples = 0, dur = 0;
          for (var i = 0; i < n && b + 16 + i * 8 <= o + size; i++) { var c = dv.getUint32(b + 8 + i * 8); samples += c; dur += c * dv.getUint32(b + 12 + i * 8); }
          cur.samples = samples; cur.sampleDuration = dur;
        } else if (cur && type === 'elst') {
          var ev = dv.getUint8(b), en = dv.getUint32(b + 4);
          var mediaTime = en ? (ev === 1 ? dv.getInt32(b + 8 + 12) : dv.getInt32(b + 8 + 4)) : 0;
          cur.editList = en > 1 || mediaTime > 0;
        }
        o += size;
      }
    }
    walk(0, buf.byteLength);
    return { mvhd: mvhd, tracks: tracks };
  }

  async function analyzeMp4(file) {
    var boxes = await topLevelBoxes(file);
    var ftyp = boxes.filter(function (b) { return b.type === 'ftyp'; })[0];
    var moov = boxes.filter(function (b) { return b.type === 'moov'; })[0];
    var mdat = boxes.filter(function (b) { return b.type === 'mdat'; })[0];
    if (!moov || moov.size > 80 * 1024 * 1024) return null;
    var out = {};
    if (ftyp) {
      var fdv = new DataView(await readSlice(file, ftyp.offset + 8, ftyp.offset + 12));
      out.container = fourcc(fdv, 0) === 'qt  ' ? 'mov' : 'mp4';
    } else out.container = 'mov';
    out.moovAtFront = mdat ? moov.offset < mdat.offset : true;
    var info = parseMoov(await readSlice(file, moov.offset + moov.header, moov.offset + moov.size));
    var vt = info.tracks.filter(function (t) { return t.handler === 'vide'; })[0];
    var at = info.tracks.filter(function (t) { return t.handler === 'soun'; })[0];
    if (vt) {
      out.videoCodec = VCODEC[vt.codec] || (vt.codec ? 'unknown' : 'unknown');
      out.videoFourcc = vt.codec;
      var mx = vt.matrix || [65536, 0, 0, 65536];
      out.rotation = mx[0] === 0 && mx[1] === 65536 ? 90 : mx[0] === 0 && mx[1] === -65536 ? 270 : mx[0] === -65536 && mx[3] === -65536 ? 180 : 0;
      var w = Math.round(vt.width), h = Math.round(vt.height);
      out.width = out.rotation % 180 ? h : w; out.height = out.rotation % 180 ? w : h;
      if (vt.timescale && vt.duration) out.durationSec = vt.duration / vt.timescale;
      if (vt.samples && vt.sampleDuration && vt.timescale) out.frameRate = Math.round(vt.samples * vt.timescale / vt.sampleDuration * 100) / 100;
      out.hasEditList = !!vt.editList;
    }
    out.audioCodec = at ? (ACODEC[at.codec] || 'unknown') : 'none';
    if (!out.durationSec && info.mvhd && info.mvhd.timescale) out.durationSec = info.mvhd.duration / info.mvhd.timescale;
    return out;
  }

  /* ---------- Browser-based fallbacks ---------- */
  function videoElementInfo(file) {
    return new Promise(function (resolve) {
      var v = document.createElement('video');
      var url = URL.createObjectURL(file);
      var done = function (val) { URL.revokeObjectURL(url); resolve(val); };
      v.preload = 'metadata'; v.muted = true;
      v.onloadedmetadata = function () { done({ width: v.videoWidth, height: v.videoHeight, durationSec: isFinite(v.duration) ? v.duration : null }); };
      v.onerror = function () { done(null); };
      setTimeout(function () { done(null); }, 8000);
      v.src = url;
    });
  }

  function imageFormatOf(file) {
    var t = (file.type || '').toLowerCase(), n = file.name.toLowerCase();
    if (/jpe?g/.test(t) || /\.jpe?g$/.test(n)) return 'jpeg';
    if (/png/.test(t) || /\.png$/.test(n)) return 'png';
    if (/webp/.test(t) || /\.webp$/.test(n)) return 'webp';
    if (/gif/.test(t) || /\.gif$/.test(n)) return 'gif';
    if (/hei[cf]/.test(t) || /\.hei[cf]$/.test(n)) return 'heic';
    if (/bmp/.test(t) || /\.bmp$/.test(n)) return 'bmp';
    if (/tiff?/.test(t) || /\.tiff?$/.test(n)) return 'tiff';
    return t.split('/')[1] || n.split('.').pop();
  }

  function isVideo(file) { return /^video\//.test(file.type) || /\.(mp4|mov|m4v|webm|avi|mkv)$/i.test(file.name); }
  function isImage(file) { return /^image\//.test(file.type) || /\.(jpe?g|png|gif|webp|heic|heif|bmp|tiff?)$/i.test(file.name); }

  /** Read everything we can about a file, locally. */
  async function analyze(file) {
    var base = { fileName: file.name, mimeType: file.type || '', sizeBytes: file.size };
    if (isVideo(file)) {
      base.kind = 'video';
      var info = null;
      if (!/\.(webm|mkv|avi)$/i.test(file.name)) { try { info = await analyzeMp4(file); } catch (e) { info = null; } }
      if (!info) {
        info = { container: (file.name.split('.').pop() || '').toLowerCase().replace('m4v', 'mp4'), videoCodec: /webm/.test(file.type) ? 'unknown' : 'unknown', audioCodec: 'unknown' };
      }
      if (!info.width || !info.durationSec) {
        var el = await videoElementInfo(file);
        if (el) { info.width = info.width || el.width; info.height = info.height || el.height; info.durationSec = info.durationSec || el.durationSec; }
      }
      Object.assign(base, info);
      if (base.durationSec) base.bitrate = Math.round(file.size * 8 / base.durationSec);
    } else if (isImage(file)) {
      base.kind = 'image';
      base.imageFormat = imageFormatOf(file);
      try {
        var bmp = await createImageBitmap(file);
        base.width = bmp.width; base.height = bmp.height; bmp.close && bmp.close();
      } catch (e) { /* e.g. HEIC in Chrome */ }
    } else {
      throw new Error('“' + file.name + '” isn’t a photo or video.');
    }
    if (base.width && base.height) base.aspectRatio = Rules.ratioLabel(base.width, base.height);
    return base;
  }

  /* ---------- Thumbnails ---------- */
  function canvasToSmallJpeg(source, sw, sh) {
    var max = 360, scale = Math.min(1, max / Math.max(sw, sh));
    var c = document.createElement('canvas');
    c.width = Math.max(1, Math.round(sw * scale)); c.height = Math.max(1, Math.round(sh * scale));
    var ctx = c.getContext('2d');
    ctx.fillStyle = '#F4F8F5'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, c.width, c.height);
    ctx.drawImage(source, 0, 0, c.width, c.height);
    var q = 0.75, data = c.toDataURL('image/jpeg', q);
    while (data.length > 45000 && q > 0.3) { q -= 0.1; data = c.toDataURL('image/jpeg', q); }
    return data;
  }

  function thumbnail(file, meta) {
    if (meta.kind === 'image') {
      return createImageBitmap(file).then(function (bmp) { var d = canvasToSmallJpeg(bmp, bmp.width, bmp.height); bmp.close && bmp.close(); return d; }).catch(function () { return ''; });
    }
    return new Promise(function (resolve) {
      var v = document.createElement('video'), url = URL.createObjectURL(file), finished = false;
      function done(val) { if (finished) return; finished = true; URL.revokeObjectURL(url); resolve(val || ''); }
      v.muted = true; v.playsInline = true; v.preload = 'auto';
      v.onloadeddata = function () { v.currentTime = Math.min(1, (v.duration || 2) * 0.1); };
      v.onseeked = function () { try { done(canvasToSmallJpeg(v, v.videoWidth, v.videoHeight)); } catch (e) { done(''); } };
      v.onerror = function () { done(''); };
      setTimeout(function () { done(''); }, 10000);
      v.src = url;
    });
  }

  /** Capture a frame at `t` seconds from a Drive-hosted video element (cover picker). */
  function frameFromVideo(videoEl) { return canvasToSmallJpeg(videoEl, videoEl.videoWidth, videoEl.videoHeight); }

  /* ---------- Upload to Google Drive ---------- */
  var ctx = null, ctxAt = 0;
  function context() {
    if (ctx && Date.now() - ctxAt < 40 * 60000) return Promise.resolve(ctx);
    return CRS.server('getUploadContext').then(function (c) { ctx = c; ctxAt = Date.now(); return c; });
  }

  function xhrSend(method, url, headers, body, onProgress) {
    return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
      var x = new XMLHttpRequest();
      x.open(method, url);
      Object.keys(headers).forEach(function (k) { x.setRequestHeader(k, headers[k]); });
      if (x.upload && onProgress) x.upload.onprogress = function (e) { if (e.lengthComputable) onProgress(e.loaded / e.total); };
      x.onload = function () {
        if (x.status >= 200 && x.status < 300) { try { resolve(JSON.parse(x.responseText)); } catch (e) { resolve({}); } }
        else reject(new Error('Upload failed (' + x.status + '): ' + x.responseText.slice(0, 200)));
      };
      x.onerror = function () { reject(new Error('Network error while uploading. Check your connection and try again.')); };
      x.send(body);
    });
  }

  async function upload(file, folderId, onProgress) {
    var c = await context();
    var auth = { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + c.token };
    var meta = { name: file.name, parents: [folderId] };
    var type = file.type || 'application/octet-stream';
    var base = 'https://www.googleapis.com/upload/drive/v3/files';
    // 1) Resumable session (handles large videos).
    try {
      var init = await fetch(base + '?uploadType=resumable&fields=id,name,size', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: Object.assign({ 'Content-Type': 'application/json; charset=UTF-8', 'X-Upload-Content-Type': type, 'X-Upload-Content-Length': String(file.size) }, auth),
        body: JSON.stringify(meta)
      });
      var loc = init.ok && init.headers.get('Location');
      if (loc) return await xhrSend('PUT', loc, { 'Content-Type': type }, file, onProgress);
      if (!init.ok) throw new Error('Drive said ' + init.status);
    } catch (e) {
      if (file.size > 200 * 1024 * 1024) throw e;
    }
    // 2) Fallback: single multipart request.
    var boundary = 'crs' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2);
    var body = new Blob(['--' + boundary + '\r\nContent-Type: application/json; charset=UTF-8\r\n\r\n' + JSON.stringify(meta) +
      '\r\n--' + boundary + '\r\nContent-Type: ' + type + '\r\n\r\n', file, '\r\n--' + boundary + '--']);
    return xhrSend('POST', base + '?uploadType=multipart&fields=id,name,size', Object.assign({ 'Content-Type': 'multipart/related; boundary=' + boundary }, auth), body, onProgress);
  }

  /* ---------- Viewing originals ---------- */
  var urlCache = {};
  function originalUrl(m, onProgress) {
    if (urlCache[m.id]) return Promise.resolve(urlCache[m.id]);
    if (CRS.mock) return Promise.resolve(m.thumbData || '');
    return context().then(function (c) {
      return new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
        var x = new XMLHttpRequest();
        x.open('GET', 'https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/files/' + encodeURIComponent(m.driveFileId) + '?alt=media');
        x.setRequestHeader('Authorization', 'Bearer ' + c.token);
        x.responseType = 'blob';
        x.onprogress = function (e) { if (onProgress && e.lengthComputable) onProgress(e.loaded / e.total); };
        x.onload = function () {
          if (x.status >= 300) return reject(new Error('Couldn’t load the original from Drive (' + x.status + ').'));
          var u = URL.createObjectURL(x.response); urlCache[m.id] = u; resolve(u);
        };
        x.onerror = function () { reject(new Error('Network error loading from Drive.')); };
        x.send();
      });
    });
  }

  /* ---------- Full import pipeline ---------- */
  function defaultFolder(meta) { return meta.kind === 'video' ? 'Videos and Reels' : 'Product Photography'; }

  /**
   * importFiles(files, folderName|null, onUpdate) — analyze, thumbnail, upload, register.
   * onUpdate(job) is called as each file progresses: job.status = analyzing|uploading|saving|done|error.
   */
  async function importFiles(files, folderName, onUpdate) {
    var c = CRS.mock ? { folders: [] } : await context();
    var results = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < files.length; i++) {
      var file = files[i];
      var job = { key: file.name + ':' + file.size + ':' + i, name: file.name, status: 'analyzing', progress: 0 };
      onUpdate(job);
      try {
        var meta = await analyze(file);
        job.kind = meta.kind; job.status = 'uploading'; onUpdate(job);
        meta.thumbData = await thumbnail(file, meta);
        job.thumbData = meta.thumbData; onUpdate(job);
        var folder = folderName || defaultFolder(meta);
        var folderObj = c.folders.filter(function (f) { return f.name === folder; })[0];
        var uploaded;
        if (CRS.mock) {
          for (var p = 1; p <= 5; p++) { await new Promise(function (r) { setTimeout(r, 120); }); job.progress = p / 5; onUpdate(job); }
          uploaded = { id: 'mock-' + Math.random().toString(36).slice(2) };
        } else {
          if (!folderObj) throw new Error('Folder “' + folder + '” not found.');
          uploaded = await upload(file, folderObj.id, function (f) { job.progress = f; onUpdate(job); });
        }
        job.status = 'saving'; job.progress = 1; onUpdate(job);
        meta.driveFileId = uploaded.id;
        meta.folder = folder;
        meta.driveFolderId = folderObj ? folderObj.id : '';
        meta.tags = [];
        var saved = await CRS.server('registerMedia', meta);
        job.status = 'done'; job.media = saved; onUpdate(job);
        results.push(saved);
      } catch (err) {
        job.status = 'error'; job.error = err && err.message ? err.message : String(err); onUpdate(job);
      }
    }
    return results;
  }

  window.MediaKit = {
    analyze: analyze, thumbnail: thumbnail, upload: upload, importFiles: importFiles,
    originalUrl: originalUrl, frameFromVideo: frameFromVideo, isVideo: isVideo, isImage: isImage,
    _parseMoov: parseMoov, _analyzeMp4: analyzeMp4
  };
})();
</script>

/**
 * PLATFORM REQUIREMENTS — the single place to update when a platform changes its rules.
 * Sources (checked Oct 31, 2026): Meta Instagram Graph API media reference, Meta Reels
 * Publishing API, TikTok Content Posting API media transfer guide, YouTube Help (Shorts),
 * Pinterest API / media guidelines. Each limit notes whether it's a hard rule ("max")
 * or a recommendation ("recommended").
 */
(function () {
  var MB = 1024 * 1024, GB = 1024 * MB;

  var RULES = {
    instagram: {
      name: 'Instagram', abbr: 'IG', color: 'var(--pf-instagram)',
      text: { caption: 2200, hashtags: 5, mentions: 20 },
      fields: [],
      formats: {
        feed: { label: 'Feed post', kinds: ['image'], count: [1, 1],
          image: { formats: ['jpeg'], convertible: ['png', 'webp', 'gif'], maxBytes: 8 * MB, ratio: [0.8, 1.91], minWidth: 320, maxWidth: 1440 } },
        carousel: { label: 'Carousel', kinds: ['image', 'video'], count: [2, 10],
          image: { formats: ['jpeg'], convertible: ['png', 'webp', 'gif'], maxBytes: 8 * MB, ratio: [0.8, 1.91] },
          video: { containers: ['mp4', 'mov'], vcodecs: ['h264', 'hevc'], acodecs: ['aac', 'none'], fps: [23, 60], maxWidth: 1920, duration: [3, 900], maxBytes: 300 * MB } },
        reel: { label: 'Reel', kinds: ['video'], count: [1, 1],
          video: { containers: ['mp4', 'mov'], vcodecs: ['h264', 'hevc'], acodecs: ['aac', 'none'], fps: [23, 60], maxWidth: 1920,
            ratio: [0.01, 10], recommendedRatio: 9 / 16, duration: [3, 900], maxBytes: 300 * MB, maxBitrate: 25e6, moovAtFront: true } }
      },
      notes: ['Captions and tags aren’t supported on individual carousel items.', 'Reels can’t be part of a carousel.']
    },
    facebook: {
      name: 'Facebook', abbr: 'FB', color: 'var(--pf-facebook)',
      text: { caption: 63206 },
      formats: {
        post: { label: 'Post', kinds: ['image', 'none'], count: [0, 10],
          image: { formats: ['jpeg', 'png', 'gif', 'bmp', 'tiff', 'webp'], maxBytes: 10 * MB } },
        reel: { label: 'Reel', kinds: ['video'], count: [1, 1],
          video: { containers: ['mp4', 'mov'], vcodecs: ['h264', 'hevc', 'vp9', 'av1'], acodecs: ['aac', 'none'], fps: [24, 60],
            minWidth: 540, minHeight: 960, recommendedRatio: 9 / 16, requireVertical: true, duration: [3, 90] } },
        video: { label: 'Video post', kinds: ['video'], count: [1, 1],
          video: { containers: ['mp4', 'mov'], vcodecs: ['h264', 'hevc', 'vp9', 'av1'], acodecs: ['aac', 'none'], duration: [1, 14400], maxBytes: 10 * GB } }
      },
      notes: ['Facebook Page Reels can be 3–90 seconds; Facebook can schedule them natively up to 29 days ahead.']
    },
    tiktok: {
      name: 'TikTok', abbr: 'TT', color: 'var(--pf-tiktok)',
      text: { caption: 2200 },
      formats: {
        video: { label: 'Video', kinds: ['video'], count: [1, 1],
          video: { containers: ['mp4', 'mov', 'webm'], vcodecs: ['h264', 'hevc', 'vp8', 'vp9'], acodecs: ['aac', 'opus', 'none', 'mp3'], fps: [23, 60],
            minDim: 360, maxDim: 4096, recommendedRatio: 9 / 16, duration: [3, 600], maxBytes: 4 * GB } },
        photo: { label: 'Photo post', kinds: ['image'], count: [1, 35],
          image: { formats: ['jpeg', 'webp'], convertible: ['png'], maxBytes: 20 * MB, maxDim: 1920 } }
      },
      notes: ['Until TikTok approves (audits) the app, posts can only be published as private. The “Send to TikTok inbox” option lets you finish and post publicly in the TikTok app.']
    },
    youtube: {
      name: 'YouTube', abbr: 'YT', color: 'var(--pf-youtube)',
      text: { title: 100, description: 5000, descriptionBytes: true, tags: 500 },
      formats: {
        short: { label: 'Short', kinds: ['video'], count: [1, 1],
          video: { containers: ['mp4', 'mov', 'webm', 'avi', 'mkv'], vcodecs: ['h264', 'hevc', 'vp9', 'av1', 'vp8', 'prores', 'mpeg4'], acodecs: ['aac', 'opus', 'mp3', 'pcm', 'none'],
            maxRatio: 1, recommendedRatio: 9 / 16, duration: [1, 180] } },
        video: { label: 'Video', kinds: ['video'], count: [1, 1],
          video: { containers: ['mp4', 'mov', 'webm', 'avi', 'mkv'], vcodecs: ['h264', 'hevc', 'vp9', 'av1', 'vp8', 'prores', 'mpeg4'], acodecs: ['aac', 'opus', 'mp3', 'pcm', 'none'],
            duration: [1, 43200], unverifiedMax: 900 } }
      },
      notes: ['YouTube decides Shorts automatically: square or vertical videos up to 3 minutes.', 'Uploads stay private until Google approves the app’s API audit.']
    },
    pinterest: {
      name: 'Pinterest', abbr: 'P', color: 'var(--pf-pinterest)',
      text: { title: 100, description: 800 },
      formats: {
        image: { label: 'Image Pin', kinds: ['image'], count: [1, 1],
          image: { formats: ['jpeg', 'png', 'gif', 'webp', 'bmp', 'tiff'], maxBytes: 20 * MB, recommendedRatio: 2 / 3 } },
        carousel: { label: 'Carousel Pin', kinds: ['image'], count: [2, 5],
          image: { formats: ['jpeg', 'png', 'webp'], maxBytes: 20 * MB, recommendedRatio: 2 / 3, sameSize: true } },

    mediaSummary: function (m) {
      var res = {};
      ORDER.forEach(function (p) {
        var fmts = Object.keys(RULES[p].formats).filter(function (f) { return RULES[p].formats[f].kinds.indexOf(m.kind) !== -1; });
        var best = null;
        fmts.forEach(function (f) {
          var c = checkMedia(m, p, f);
          var rank = { green: 0, yellow: 1, red: 2 }[c.level];
          if (!best || rank < best.rank) best = { rank: rank, level: c.level, format: f, issues: c.issues };
        });
        res[p] = best || { level: 'na', format: null, issues: [{ level: 'na', text: RULES[p].name + ' doesn’t take ' + (m.kind === 'image' ? 'photos' : 'videos') + ' by API.' }] };
      });
      return res;
    }
  };
})();
</script>

<style>
:root {
  /* Brand */
  --green: #8BC4A9;
  --green-500: #74B395;
  --forest: #4C6D5E;
  --forest-700: #3D5A4D;
  --forest-800: #2F473C;
  --white: #FFFFFF;
  /* Supporting */
  --warm-white: #FFFDF9;
  --sage-25: #FAFCFA;
  --sage-50: #F4F8F5;
  --sage-100: #EAF3EE;
  --sage-150: #E0EDE5;
  --sage-200: #D3E5DA;
  --line: #E4ECE7;
  --ink: #2C3832;
  --ink-2: #4E5C55;
  --muted: #74827A;
  --muted-2: #9AA79F;
  /* Status (soft, never used for chart series) */
  --st-draft-bg: #F0F2F1;   --st-draft: #5F6B65;
  --st-sched-bg: #E7F0F8;   --st-sched: #3F6B8F;
  --st-pub-bg: #E4F2EA;     --st-pub: #2F7A55;
  --st-publishing-bg: #EEEBF8; --st-publishing: #5D52A0;
  --st-fail-bg: #FBEBEB;    --st-fail: #A8464C;
  --st-warn-bg: #FFF4DF;    --st-warn: #94661A;
  /* Platforms (muted, always paired with a text label) */
  --pf-instagram: #B85C8A;
  --pf-facebook: #4E6FAE;
  --pf-tiktok: #2C3832;
  --pf-youtube: #C4564F;
  --pf-pinterest: #A8495C;

  --radius-sm: 10px;
  --radius: 16px;
  --radius-lg: 22px;
  --shadow-sm: 0 1px 2px rgba(47, 71, 60, .05);
  --shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(47, 71, 60, .04), 0 6px 22px rgba(47, 71, 60, .06);
  --shadow-lg: 0 12px 40px rgba(47, 71, 60, .14);
  --font-head: "Amatic SC", "Patrick Hand", cursive;
  --font: "Plus Jakarta Sans", "Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
  --sidebar-w: 252px;
  --sidebar-w-collapsed: 78px;
  --topbar-h: 72px;
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; }
html, body { margin: 0; height: 100%; }
body {
  font-family: var(--font);
  font-size: 14.5px;
  line-height: 1.55;
  color: var(--ink);
  background: var(--sage-50);
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
}
a { color: var(--forest); }
button { font: inherit; color: inherit; }
svg.i { width: 18px; height: 18px; stroke: currentColor; fill: none; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; flex: none; }
[data-icon] { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
[hidden] { display: none !important; }
.muted { color: var(--muted); }

/* ---------- Layout ---------- */
.app { display: flex; min-height: 100vh; }
.main { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }

/* ---------- Sidebar ---------- */
.sidebar {
  width: var(--sidebar-w); flex: none;
  background: var(--white);
  border-right: 1px solid var(--line);
  display: flex; flex-direction: column;
  position: sticky; top: 0; height: 100vh;
  transition: width .22s ease;
  z-index: 30;
}
.sidebar-brand { padding: 18px 20px 14px; text-align: center; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.brand-full { width: 118px; height: auto; display: block; margin: 0 auto; }
.brand-mark { width: 38px; height: 38px; display: none; margin: 0 auto; }
.brand-sub {
  display: inline-block; margin-top: 10px;
  font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--forest); background: var(--sage-100); padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px;
}
.nav { flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; padding: 14px 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
.nav-group { font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted-2); padding: 14px 12px 6px; }
.nav-item {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
  padding: 9px 12px; border-radius: 12px;
  color: var(--ink-2); text-decoration: none; font-weight: 500;
  position: relative; white-space: nowrap;
}
.nav-item:hover { background: var(--sage-50); color: var(--forest-700); }
.nav-item.active { background: var(--sage-100); color: var(--forest-800); font-weight: 600; }
.nav-item.active::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: -12px; top: 9px; bottom: 9px; width: 3px; border-radius: 0 3px 3px 0; background: var(--green); }
.nav-item .ico { color: var(--muted); }
.nav-item.active .ico, .nav-item:hover .ico { color: var(--forest); }
.nav-item .count { margin-left: auto; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 600; background: var(--sage-150); color: var(--forest-700); border-radius: 999px; padding: 1px 8px; }
.sidebar-foot { padding: 12px; border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
.collapse-btn {
  width: 100%; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
  border: 0; background: transparent; padding: 9px 12px; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; color: var(--muted);
}
.collapse-btn:hover { background: var(--sage-50); color: var(--forest); }

/* Collapsed */
.app[data-sidebar="collapsed"] .sidebar { width: var(--sidebar-w-collapsed); }
.app[data-sidebar="collapsed"] .brand-full,
.app[data-sidebar="collapsed"] .brand-sub,
.app[data-sidebar="collapsed"] .nav-item .label,
.app[data-sidebar="collapsed"] .nav-item .count,
.app[data-sidebar="collapsed"] .nav-group,
.app[data-sidebar="collapsed"] .collapse-btn .label { display: none; }
.app[data-sidebar="collapsed"] .brand-mark { display: block; }
.app[data-sidebar="collapsed"] .sidebar-brand { padding: 20px 10px; }
.app[data-sidebar="collapsed"] .nav-item,
.app[data-sidebar="collapsed"] .collapse-btn { justify-content: center; padding: 11px; }
.app[data-sidebar="collapsed"] .nav-group { display: block; height: 1px; padding: 0; margin: 10px 8px; background: var(--line); font-size: 0; }
.app[data-sidebar="collapsed"] .collapse-btn .ico { transform: scaleX(-1); }

/* ---------- Topbar ---------- */
.topbar {
  height: var(--topbar-h); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px;
  padding: 0 28px; background: rgba(250, 252, 250, .86);
  backdrop-filter: saturate(1.2) blur(10px);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
  position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 20;
}
.topbar-title { min-width: 0; }
.topbar-title h1 { font-family: var(--font-head); font-weight: 700; font-size: 34px; line-height: 1; margin: 0; color: var(--forest); letter-spacing: .02em; }
.topbar-title p { margin: 3px 0 0; font-size: 12.5px; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.topbar-actions { margin-left: auto; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
.search {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 280px;
  background: var(--white); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 12px; padding: 0 12px; height: 40px; color: var(--muted);
}
.search:focus-within { border-color: var(--green); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(139, 196, 169, .25); }
.search input { border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; font: inherit; color: var(--ink); width: 100%; }
.tz-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--muted); padding: 0 6px; white-space: nowrap; }
.tz-chip svg.i { width: 15px; height: 15px; }
.icon-btn {
  width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--white);
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; color: var(--ink-2); position: relative;
}
.icon-btn:hover { border-color: var(--sage-200); color: var(--forest); }
.badge-dot { position: absolute; top: 9px; right: 10px; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--st-fail); border: 2px solid var(--white); }
.notif-wrap { position: relative; }
.popover {
  position: absolute; right: 0; top: 48px; width: 340px; background: var(--white);
  border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius); box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); padding: 8px; z-index: 40;
}
.popover h4 { margin: 6px 10px 8px; font-size: 13px; }

/* ---------- Buttons ---------- */
.btn {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px;
  border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid transparent; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px;
  text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap;
}
.btn svg.i { width: 17px; height: 17px; }
.btn-primary { background: var(--forest); color: var(--white); }
.btn-primary:hover { background: var(--forest-700); }
.btn-soft { background: var(--sage-100); color: var(--forest-700); }
.btn-soft:hover { background: var(--sage-150); }
.btn-ghost { background: var(--white); border-color: var(--line); color: var(--ink-2); }
.btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--sage-200); color: var(--forest); }
.btn-sm { height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; font-size: 13px; border-radius: 10px; }
:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--green); outline-offset: 2px; }

/* ---------- Content ---------- */
.content { flex: 1; padding: 28px; max-width: 1360px; width: 100%; margin: 0 auto; outline: none; }
.loading { min-height: 60vh; display: grid; place-content: center; text-align: center; color: var(--muted); }
.loading img { width: 56px; margin: 0 auto 10px; animation: breathe 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes breathe { 50% { transform: scale(1.08); opacity: .7; } }

.sample-banner {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 16px; margin-bottom: 22px;
  background: var(--warm-white); border: 1px dashed #E3CF9E; border-radius: var(--radius); color: #7A5A1E; font-size: 13.5px;
}
.sample-banner strong { color: #6A4C14; }
.sample-tag { font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; background: #FFF1D2; color: #8A6216; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 999px; white-space: nowrap; }

.greeting { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; margin-bottom: 20px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.greeting h2 { font-family: var(--font-head); font-size: 44px; line-height: 1; margin: 0; color: var(--forest); letter-spacing: .02em; }
.greeting p { margin: 6px 0 0; color: var(--muted); }

.grid { display: grid; gap: 20px; }
.kpis { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); margin-bottom: 20px; }
.row-2-1 { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 2fr) minmax(0, 1fr); margin-bottom: 20px; }
.row-3-2 { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 3fr) minmax(0, 2fr); }

.card { background: var(--white); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); box-shadow: var(--shadow); padding: 22px; min-width: 0; }
.card-head { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; margin-bottom: 16px; }
.card-head h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 15.5px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--ink); }
.card-head .sub { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 2px; }
.link-btn { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--forest); text-decoration: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; }
.link-btn:hover { text-decoration: underline; }
button.link-btn { border: 0; background: none; cursor: pointer; font: inherit; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; padding: 4px 6px; color: var(--forest); }

/* KPI tiles */
.kpi { position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
.kpi .kpi-top { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; }
.kpi .kpi-label { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--muted); }
.kpi .kpi-icon { width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 11px; background: var(--sage-100); color: var(--forest); display: grid; place-items: center; }
.kpi .kpi-value { font-size: 32px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -.02em; margin: 10px 0 4px; color: var(--ink); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.kpi .kpi-foot { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--muted); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.delta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--st-pub); }
.delta.down { color: var(--st-fail); }
.kpi .spark { position: absolute; right: 22px; top: 68px; width: 84px; height: 34px; }

/* Segmented control */
.seg { display: inline-flex; background: var(--sage-50); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 11px; padding: 3px; }
.seg button { border: 0; background: transparent; padding: 5px 11px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--muted); cursor: pointer; }
.seg button.on { background: var(--white); color: var(--forest-700); box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm); }

/* Charts */
.chart { width: 100%; height: 240px; position: relative; }
.chart svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; overflow: visible; }
.chart .grid-line { stroke: var(--line); stroke-width: 1; }
.chart .axis-label { fill: var(--muted-2); font-size: 11px; font-family: var(--font); }
.chart-tip {
  position: fixed; pointer-events: none; z-index: 60; background: var(--forest-800); color: var(--white);
  font-size: 12.5px; padding: 8px 11px; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); white-space: nowrap;
}
.chart-tip b { display: block; font-size: 14px; }
.chart-summary { display: flex; gap: 22px; margin-bottom: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.chart-summary .big { font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
.chart-summary .lbl { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); }

/* Platform followers */
.pf-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; }
.pf-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 112px 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px; font-size: 13.5px; cursor: default; }
.pf-row .bar-track { height: 10px; background: var(--sage-50); border-radius: 999px; overflow: hidden; }
.pf-row .bar { height: 100%; background: var(--green); border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0; min-width: 4px; transition: background .15s; }
.pf-row:hover .bar { background: var(--forest); }
.pf-row .num { font-weight: 700; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; min-width: 52px; text-align: right; }

/* Platform chips */
.pf { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink-2); min-width: 0; }
.pf-dot { width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 7px; display: grid; place-items: center; color: var(--white); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; flex: none; letter-spacing: .02em; }
.pf-dot.sm { width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 9px; }
.pf-stack { display: inline-flex; }
.pf-stack .pf-dot { border: 2px solid var(--white); margin-left: -5px; box-sizing: content-box; }
.pf-stack .pf-dot:first-child { margin-left: 0; }

/* Status pills */
.status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; padding: 3px 10px 3px 8px; border-radius: 999px; white-space: nowrap; }
.status svg.i { width: 13px; height: 13px; stroke-width: 2.2; }
.status.draft { background: var(--st-draft-bg); color: var(--st-draft); }
.status.scheduled { background: var(--st-sched-bg); color: var(--st-sched); }
.status.publishing { background: var(--st-publishing-bg); color: var(--st-publishing); }
.status.published { background: var(--st-pub-bg); color: var(--st-pub); }
.status.failed { background: var(--st-fail-bg); color: var(--st-fail); }
.status.attention, .status.partial { background: var(--st-warn-bg); color: var(--st-warn); }

/* Upcoming posts */
.post-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.post-row {
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 56px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 14px; align-items: center;
  padding: 12px; margin: 0 -12px; border-radius: 14px; text-decoration: none; color: inherit; cursor: pointer;
}
.post-row + .post-row { border-top: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: 0 0 14px 14px; }
.post-row:hover { background: var(--sage-50); border-top-color: transparent; border-radius: 14px; }
.thumb { width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 13px; display: grid; place-items: center; position: relative; color: var(--forest); flex: none; }
.thumb svg.i { width: 24px; height: 24px; stroke-width: 1.6; }
.thumb .vid { position: absolute; right: 4px; bottom: 4px; width: 18px; height: 18px; border-radius: 6px; background: rgba(47, 71, 60, .75); color: var(--white); display: grid; place-items: center; }
.thumb .vid svg.i { width: 10px; height: 10px; fill: currentColor; stroke-width: 0; }
.post-title { font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.post-caption { font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; margin: 1px 0 6px; }
.post-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--ink-2); flex-wrap: wrap; }
.post-meta .when { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; }
.post-meta .when svg.i { width: 14px; height: 14px; color: var(--muted); }
.post-side { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; gap: 8px; }

/* Quick actions */
.qa-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 10px; }
.qa {
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 12px; border-radius: 14px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--sage-25); text-decoration: none; color: var(--ink); font-weight: 600; font-size: 13.5px;
  transition: border-color .15s, background .15s, transform .15s;
}
.qa:hover { border-color: var(--sage-200); background: var(--sage-50); transform: translateY(-1px); }
.qa .qa-ico { width: 34px; height: 34px; border-radius: 10px; background: var(--white); border: 1px solid var(--line); display: grid; place-items: center; color: var(--forest); flex: none; }
.qa.primary { background: var(--forest); color: var(--white); border-color: var(--forest); }
.qa.primary .qa-ico { background: rgba(255,255,255,.14); border-color: transparent; color: var(--white); }
.qa.primary:hover { background: var(--forest-700); }

/* Activity */
.activity { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
.act { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 30px 1fr; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 0; }
.act + .act { border-top: 1px solid var(--line); }
.act-ico { width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 10px; display: grid; place-items: center; }
.act-ico svg.i { width: 15px; height: 15px; stroke-width: 2.2; }
.act-ico.success { background: var(--st-pub-bg); color: var(--st-pub); }
.act-ico.error { background: var(--st-fail-bg); color: var(--st-fail); }
.act-ico.warning { background: var(--st-warn-bg); color: var(--st-warn); }
.act-ico.info { background: var(--st-sched-bg); color: var(--st-sched); }
.act-msg { font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--ink); }
.act-time { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 2px; display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }

/* Placeholder pages */
.placeholder { text-align: center; padding: 64px 24px; max-width: 620px; margin: 24px auto; }
.placeholder .ph-ico { width: 72px; height: 72px; border-radius: 22px; background: var(--sage-100); color: var(--forest); display: grid; place-items: center; margin: 0 auto 18px; }
.placeholder .ph-ico svg.i { width: 32px; height: 32px; stroke-width: 1.5; }
.placeholder h2 { font-family: var(--font-head); font-size: 40px; line-height: 1.05; margin: 0 0 8px; color: var(--forest); }
.placeholder p { color: var(--muted); margin: 0 auto 18px; max-width: 460px; }
.phase-chip { display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--forest); background: var(--sage-100); padding: 5px 12px; border-radius: 999px; margin-bottom: 14px; }
.feature-list { text-align: left; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 8px 20px; margin: 20px auto 0; max-width: 520px; font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--ink-2); }
.feature-list div { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: flex-start; }
.feature-list svg.i { width: 16px; height: 16px; color: var(--green-500); margin-top: 2px; stroke-width: 2.4; }

/* Settings */
.kv { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 180px 1fr; gap: 10px 16px; font-size: 13.5px; }
.kv dt { color: var(--muted); }
.kv dd { margin: 0; font-weight: 500; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.swatches { display: flex; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.swatch { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 12.5px; }
.swatch i { width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--line); display: block; }

/* Toast */
.toast {
  position: fixed; left: 50%; bottom: 24px; transform: translateX(-50%);
  background: var(--forest-800); color: var(--white); padding: 11px 16px; border-radius: 12px;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg); font-size: 13.5px; z-index: 80; max-width: calc(100% - 32px);
}

.scrim { display: none; }
.mobile-only { display: none; }

/* ---------- Responsive ---------- */
@media (max-width: 1180px) {
  .kpis { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); }
  .search { width: 200px; }
  .tz-chip { display: none; }
}
@media (max-width: 960px) {
  .row-2-1, .row-3-2 { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr); }
  .search { display: none; }
}
@media (max-width: 760px) {
  .mobile-only { display: inline-flex; }
